description: Ten unchanged original terminal layout selection cases; actual pure source module.

testEvidenceBoundary: Tests leaf-set coverage, authoritative/prior tree precedence, single/empty fallback and synthesis notification. The case titled never invents a split direction only asserts callback invocation; it does not reject the horizontal fallback implemented by source. No integrated mirror, render, split ownership or host execution parity claim.
